name: Emberwatch
author: MarshalX
description: A rules engine for effects and procs: name an effect on a unit and get a tile, a cue and a banner when it lands, stacks up or runs out. Ships a starter set for your class, and takes rules of your own captured off your target with a keybind.

preview.alt: On the left, Alerts and rules, five square alert tiles above the rules panel that produced them. On the right, An alert, a STUNNED banner across the view, the alert strip shut.

keybinds.label: Show or hide the alert strip
Watch the effect on your target

settings.label: Cue volume, on top of the game's own effects slider
Fire the rules that watch for an effect running out
Seconds left that counts as running out, for a rule that names none
Most tiles to show at once
